inputs.run_gate: probe_result.json status COMPLETE_REVIEW_REQUIRED and every evidence_sha256 entry re-hashed equal

definitions.A_alignment: For QUOTE_D0 and ORDER_D0 logged quote rows: raw data row index == ontick_seq (1-based) and raw ms == fresh_time_msc. Report aligned/misaligned counts. ORDER_D250: report the offset (raw index - ontick_seq) found by locating, from the previous offset, the raw row with the same ms and same_ms_index; report offset progression and where it changes.
definitions.B_price_semantics: For aligned rows: CURRENT_ROW if tester fresh bid==raw[i].bid and ask==raw[i].ask; PREV_ROW if equal to raw[i-1]; BOTH if both; NEITHER otherwise. Cross-tab by raw flags, tester flags, same_ms_index==0, new_bar.
definitions.C_events: All new_bar=1 rows (expected 275) and the first OnTick at/after 2026.08.03 11:20:00 and 12:30:00: raw rows in that ms (line, flags, bid, ask), tester OnTick rows in that ms (seq, same_ms_index, flags, bid, ask, new_bar).
definitions.D_interventions: Count logged rows where any of F1/F2/F3 (after iTime / CopyBuffer ATR / CopyRates) differs from F0 in time_msc, bid or ask.
definitions.E_orders: Per order: deal_time_msc - pre_request_time_msc; post_return_time_msc vs deal_time_msc; deal_price vs post_return side price (sell entry=bid, buy exit=ask); raw last row with ms <= deal_time_msc and its side price; raw first row with ms >= deal_time_msc; number of raw rows with pre_request ms < ms <= post_return ms (rows the EA could not observe while OrderSend was outstanding).
definitions.F_tester_view: tester_rows_in_ms vs raw rows in that ms; tester_last_in_ms bid/ask vs raw last row in that ms.
